messages:
anya-ops: @channel Rolling out a change to Private support-access consent flows. Effective in 21 days: support access will require an explicit, time-limited admin grant in Console or via the CLI for VPC/on-prem deployments. This is aimed at customers who prefer no standing remote debug access. Short details below.

phil-legal: quick summary from Legal: update to DPA and support terms to reflect time-limited consent tokens, explicit admin acknowledgements, and a record of the support session stored in audit logs. For air-gapped installs we will not attempt any outbound connection unless the admin enables a signed support session URL.

anya-ops: What this changes: previously on some managed Private installs we created a temporary debugging tunnel by request; going forward the admin must create a one-time grant that includes start/end time, allowed actions (logs, shell, metrics), and purpose. Once the grant expires the session tokens are invalidated and the events are recorded.

tessa-csm: CSMs: suggested customer message?

anya-ops: Two-line blurb for customers: "Support access to your Private deployment is strictly opt-in. Admins can create time-limited grants for a specific purpose; you retain full control and can audit all support sessions." We'll add this to the customer-facing docs and the CSM kit.

install-bot: CLI examples:
```bash
# create a 2-hour support grant allowing logs and metrics
redwood private support grant create --deployment prod-ny --duration 2h --actions logs,metrics --reason "investigate high-latency"

# revoke an active grant
redwood private support grant revoke --deployment prod-ny --grant-id g-abc123
```
Note: for air-gapped installs the create command outputs an opaque signed URL the admin must copy manually; the installer will refuse to POST the URL on behalf of the admin.

ops-bot: Runbook & docs: https://redwood.dev/internal/runbooks/private-support-access (internal). Pilot window scheduled: 2026-09-01 00:00-02:00 UTC for invited customers.

phil-legal: Action items from Legal: finalize DPA text and a 2-sentence sales/CS blurb (ETA 48h).

tessa-csm: Action items from CSM: prepare pilot outreach list and canned email (ETA 72h).

anya-ops: Engineering items: add console UI for grant creation, persist grant audit events, and ensure CLI/installer behaviours for air-gapped flows. ETA: UI prototype in 4 business days.

ops-bot: Deployment note: beta rollout will be config-only. No service restart expected.

anya-ops: Thanks team. If you want to join pilot testing or review the UI prototype, DM me.
